_about: The Wodrow Society's collective volume: The Miscellany of the Wodrow Society, vol. 1, ed. David Laing (Edinburgh, 1844). The name check looks for the Society's name. The Society's authored volumes have their own shelves (john-knox, calderwood, james-melville, rollock, robert-bruce). Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.
